Due to immaturity-related respiratory distress, surgical correction of the inguinal hernias was performed in the second month. ining the small intestine was identified intraoperatively, laterally to the rectus abdominis muscle, below the arcuate line, and protruding through a defect of the transversalis fascia and the transversus abdominis muscle.
